methods.label: Exclude the zero denominator
methods.explanation: An algebraic fraction is defined when its denominator is nonzero, so \(x-2\ne0\). Therefore, \(x\ne2\).
methods.levelReason: This directly applies the Grade 8 nonzero-denominator condition to a linear denominator.
